description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Calling for claims to property of intestate in Homagama,  Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520001 and to 04 other properties
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically notices calling for claims to intestate property under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land descriptions including cadastral map numbers, parcel numbers, land extents, and registration details for multiple properties. The content focuses on land title settlement and property registration processes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazette classification (Type 4).
